acceptance_criteria_verification.evidence: Read deploy/redeploy-qa.sh in full. APP_DIR=/opt/apps/letflow-qa, header names ubuntu-16gb-nbg1-1. Steps present: (1) git pull + rev-parse ref, (2) docker build backend image + docker compose up -d --force-recreate app, (3) frontend built in a throwaway node:22 container with real VITE_OIDC_AUTHORITY/VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID sourced from qa.env, written to a staging dir then atomically mv'd into web-dist (previous web-dist first mv'd to a timestamped -backup- dir before the swap -- confirmed backup-before-replace ordering at the 'Swapping frontend bundle into place' step), (4) backend /health curl-retry loop and frontend https://qa.bizdala.com/ curl -sf check, both failing the script (exit 1) on failure.

cd.yml's `on: workflow_run: workflows: ["CI"], branches: [main], types: [completed]` triggers only after CI completes on main; job-level `if: github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'` gates on CI success. Deploy step gated on step-level `steps.gate.outputs.should_deploy == 'true'`, computed from ci.yml's own already-computed backend/frontend outputs (downloaded via actions/download-artifact from the triggering run's `path-filter-outputs` artifact) -- no second diff/regex. Read ci.yml's changes job directly: it appends exactly two steps (write path-filter-outputs.txt, upload-artifact) as pure downstream consumers of steps.filter/steps.fallback outputs already computed by the pre-existing, untouched logic. Structural confirmation: a docs-only merge produces backend=false/frontend=false from the untouched filter step, propagates unchanged through the new write/upload steps, and cd.yml's gate step correctly sets should_deploy=false, skipping the deploy step -- traced end to end by reading both files, no live GitHub Actions run available to trigger in this environment (consistent with step-02a's own validation_evidence, independently re-derived here rather than trusted).

cd.yml's deploy step uses `uses: appleboy/ssh-action@v1` with `host: secrets.QA_DEPLOY_HOST`, `username: secrets.QA_DEPLOY_USER`, `key: secrets.QA_DEPLOY_SSH_KEY`, `script: bash /opt/apps/letflow-qa/deploy/redeploy-qa.sh` -- matches the requirement text's description of letflow-queue's own production cd.yml pattern (purpose-built restricted SSH key, appleboy/ssh-action). Secret names are QA-prefixed and distinct from letflow-queue's own (HETZNER_DEPLOY_*), per design doc section 2 (lib/letflow/design/req367-cd-qa-deploy.md lines 295-302) -- deliberately not yet provisioned; workflow references them without requiring they exist for code-completeness.

This is an explicit, unambiguous non-live statement naming the companion task, not an implication of completeness.
